note: Synthetic, hand-written training and evaluation messages for Tideway Scam Shield. They imitate common mobile-financial-service (MFS) scam patterns reported in Bangladesh and ordinary business messages. No message is copied from a real person; all numbers and IDs are fictional. v2 adds Bangladeshi scripts for fake office callers asking for a code, delivery-charge-first, job advance deposits, loan processing charges and fake relatives, with matching genuine messages (OTP notices, cash on delivery, salary, loan instalments).
